title: The bridge of boats
episode: The Porto Bridge Disaster  | The worst bridge collapse in history
description: On March 29, 1809, as French troops stormed Porto, crowds fled across the Ponte das Barcas, a bridge of boats over the Douro. It gave way and thousands drowned. A bronze relief on the Ribeira marks the spot.

title: The war of two brothers
episode: The Portuguese Civil War - The War of the Two Brothers
description: The civil war of 1828 to 1834 between Dom Pedro and his brother Miguel over Portugal’s crown and constitution. Pedro’s liberals held Porto through a year-long siege, and he left his heart to the city. It is kept in the Lapa church.

title: Tiles that tell history
episode: The Art Of The Azulejos - Portugal's Colored Tiles
description: On the craft of azulejos, Portugal’s painted tiles. In the hall of São Bento station, opened in 1916, about 20,000 of them show scenes from Portuguese history.
